scope: Public source discovery and local inventory comparison; private ICIT contents not inspected. Sizes are attributed historical counts or local pinned counts.
conclusion: Broad corpora already exist. This search did not establish one openly downloadable, permission-cleared package combining all the proposed layers. No claim of superiority is established.

sources.title: Interactive Corpus of Indus Texts
sources.count_basis: Andreas Fuls, CAA 2023 abstract 76, printed and PDF page 281; historical count, not current inventory.
sources.observations: Includes excavation identifiers, findspots, material, preservation, direction, completeness, iconography, spatial mapping and analysis tools.
sources.access: Official page says to ask the administrator for access. Full internal schema and current bulk release not inspected.
sources.redistribution: No open bulk-data or image redistribution license established in this review.

sources.title: Corpus of Indus Seals and Inscriptions
sources.observations: Photographic corpus project; verified publication records include volume 3.1 (2010) and 3.2 (2019). Object faces, impressions and museum/excavation references already have scholarly precedents.
sources.access: Published volumes and some publicly accessible scans; no complete openly licensed machine-readable package inspected.
sources.redistribution: Photographic assets need their own source-specific review.

sources.title: The Indus Script IM77 Web Application
sources.observations: RMRL describes a web application based on Mahadevan's 1977 book. The institution also lists an expanded concordance among planned activities.
sources.access: Public application; internal data and full export route not verified.

sources.title: Corpus of Texts in the Indus Script
sources.observations: Printed graphic texts; local project has a 687-cell chart annotation resource. Text digitization still requires source and boundary review.
sources.access: Official publication portal and public PDF.
sources.redistribution: Official portal links CC BY 4.0 for the published version; retain attribution and transformation records.

sources.title: A Concordance to the Texts in the Indus Script
sources.observations: Concordance available as an image-based PDF in the local project.
sources.access: Official publication portal and public PDF.
sources.redistribution: Official portal links CC BY 4.0 for the published version; preserve notices and source coordinates.

sources.title: Corpus of Indus Seals and Inscriptions digitization
sources.count_basis: Local pin ad2f1e218a34b8c33c57de0d6cb8d99272765bbb; no fresh count of upstream main.
sources.observations: Parpola-style signs with feature vectors, line, damage and uncertainty annotations. Local subset is Mohenjo-daro unicorn seals.
sources.access: Public GitHub JSON and feature schema.
sources.redistribution: Actual MIT notice, Michael Carlson 2024. Separately sourced photographs retain their own rights.

sources.title: Lipi inscription export
sources.count_basis: Local pin fc8813a52e183d19c441631dc26c33a4dccbea39; aggregate replay in main-v1/local-input-audit.json.
sources.observations: Broad metadata export. Source interpretations are excluded from our observed-data extraction.
sources.access: Public source repository; already preserved locally.
sources.redistribution: No license found at local pin; current GitHub repository metadata also returns license null. Public accessibility alone does not clear a bulk release.

sources.title: Earlier Indus website export
sources.observations: Earlier overlapping export from the same maintainer; useful for version comparison.
sources.access: Already preserved locally and parsed as text.
sources.redistribution: Upstream repository GPL-3.0; imported data and image coverage needs component review.

sources.title: Indus Valley Script Corpus
sources.observations: README identifies Lipi as the CSV source; alternate availability does not add independent objects.
sources.redistribution: GitHub reports MIT; scope of inherited Lipi and ICIT material remains unresolved.

sources.title: Synthetic Indus Script Dataset
sources.observations: Generated sequences and a sign index; these are not newly discovered archaeological inscriptions. The API file list differs from parts of the card's file descriptions.
sources.access: Public Hugging Face repository, pinned e455cfc7e9069ade81ce994b47b7a7533308627e.
sources.redistribution: Card declares CC BY 4.0. No independent review of all source-derived index fields.

sources.title: Zer0pa Indus Valley lane state
sources.observations: Card describes a research-state and source-code mirror with derived integer data and no image bytes admitted. Includes a demonstration fixture; full bundles not acquired.
sources.access: API metadata and pinned card acquired; web reader could not open its normal page.
sources.redistribution: Custom policy. No blanket reusable full archaeological corpus established.

sources.title: P316 P147 P217 Indus Branch Audit Article Assets
sources.observations: Article assets, named-sign route tables, summaries and image comparisons. Card's checked-artifact count is not a census of independent ancient objects.
sources.access: API metadata and pinned card acquired; bulk assets not acquired.
sources.redistribution: Card declares CC BY 4.0; permissions for reproduced third-party panels require separate review.

sources.title: Indus Valley Script Dataset
sources.observations: Book-derived isolated character PNGs, useful for graphic experiments rather than a complete object corpus.
sources.redistribution: GitHub repository metadata has no detected license; original image rights not established.

sources.title: IM 417 150
sources.observations: Referenced by jocchanon-prog/induscorpus as a 150 by 150 pixel glyph collection. Original Kaggle payload and rights were not independently inspected.
sources.access: Discovery reference only in this review.
sources.redistribution: Downstream README states Apache 2.0; original publication and crop permissions remain unverified.

sources.title: Open Indus Lab
sources.observations: Current README lists author readings and sign-to-phoneme hypotheses, and reports removal of its external CISI corpus and guessed numbering bridge in July 2026.
sources.access: Public repository and seed CSVs; counts attributed to README, not independently recounted.
sources.redistribution: README declares MIT and author permission. Imported assets require individual review.

sources.title: Induscript research compilation
sources.observations: Site describes an ICIT-style compilation and graphic stand-ins; it expressly limits its photographic completeness. Similar functions have existing precedents.
sources.access: Public website; no complete bulk payload examined.
sources.redistribution: Full source and asset license not established here.

sources.title: The Ledger of Meluhha
sources.observations: Public description combines transcription data, OCR, metadata and an author's numerical interpretation. Database contents were not downloaded or independently evaluated.
sources.redistribution: Page states separate restrictions on AI use and mixed third-party data. Exclude payload from acquisition or release pending a documented basis.

sources.title: The Indus script optical grapheme recognition engine
sources.observations: Image text localization, segmentation and grapheme recognition project; not evaluated as a holistic archaeological corpus.
sources.access: Public repository; no training payload acquired in this audit.
sources.redistribution: GitHub reports Apache 2.0 for the repository; training-image rights must be checked separately.
